eula.clause.asIs.body: This software is provided AS-IS with no warranty of any kind. The developer accepts no liability for loss or corruption of data caused by unexpected bugs, changes to external services, or cloud sync failures. Please keep your own copies of anything important.
eula.note: If you do not agree, you cannot use this app. You can review or withdraw your consent later from the General tab in Settings.
eula.revokeConfirmBody: Revoking your consent will NOT deactivate your license, but you will not be able to use the app until you agree again. Revoke?
